items.ref: Mu Gwekkumi gwa 2008, abakulira ebitongole by'ebyokwerinda baasisinkana okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku nsonga y'abaliko abayeekera ba ADF balumiriza gavumenti okubakozesa.

items.hyp: Aba ADF baali beegattirwamu gavumenti okukola mu kubaawo abantu era n'okukola ssente zaabwe.
items.ref: Abaaliko abayeekera ba Allied Democratic Forces baalumizizza gavumenti okubakozesa n'ebasuulawo nga tebasasudde.

items.hyp: Abatujju nga bakkirizibwa mu Kampala mu Jjulaayi nga 11 baakola ku bikolwa bya ADF ne basirikale b'Abasinga obungi b'ekibiina kya Al-Shabaab.
items.ref: Obulumbanyi bwa bbomu obwali mu Kampala nga 11 Ogwomusanvu bwava ku nkolagana wakati wa ADF ne bamukwatammundu Abasiraamu aba Al-Shabaab abasangibwa e Somalia.

items.hyp: Olw'okuba abantu abamu baali bafuba okukola ennyimba, abantu ab'ekibiina kya ADF baagala okukola ennyimba mu kubba abantu mu bakyayi.
items.ref: Olw'embeera enzibu era ey'okwennyamira gye bawangaaliramu, bannamawulire ba Allied Democratic Forces abatamanyi kiddako baddiziddwa mu bikolwa by'obutujju.

items.hyp: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe ne be bamu ku abo abalala aba ADF abaali bakulembera abakulembera abalala.
items.ref: Abdusalam Lukwebe Mwebe n'abalala be bamu ku baali bammemba ba Allied Democratic Forces.

items.hyp: Alipoota ya Independenti olwo lwaliwo nga Jjulaayi 2010 lwe yagamba nti abantu ba ADF abakulembera ssente tebannatandika era nti abakulembera badda badda mu ggwanga.
items.ref: Independent w'Ogomusanvu, 2010, yawandiika nti abooluganda b'abaaliko mmemba wa ADF tebafuna buyambi kyokka ng'abaami baabwe baafiira ku mirimu gya Gavumenti.

items.hyp: Ekikolagana eky'okukuba abantu mu Kampala kisobola okukola ku kuba nti abantu mu Kampala baali basobola okukola ku kuba nti abantu mu kibuga kya Kampala baali basobola okulaga nti abo abantu mu kibuga kya Kampala baatiisatiisa.
items.ref: Kampala City Council Authority lubeerera ekubiriza bannakampala okuba abayonjo.

items.hyp: Ekyo kye kisoboka okukola kubanga abo abeesimbawo nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan mu bifo.
items.ref: Ekino kiviiriddemu bannaabwe nga Rwigyema Shafik ne Tumusiime Hassan ebuzibu.
